title: Air Canada’s chatbot lied. A court made them pay. #shorts
description:
An airline chatbot invented a refund rule, and the airline argued the chatbot was "a separate legal entity". The tribunal disagreed.

Source: Moffatt v. Air Canada, 2024 BCCRT 149, Civil Resolution Tribunal of British Columbia (14 Feb 2024).
Photos: Wikimedia Commons and Flickr, credits on file. Narration is a synthetic voice.
